reference_sql:
SELECT t.parent_category, ROUND(SUM(t.revenue_eur) / SUM(t.units), 2) AS revenue_per_unit_eur
FROM (
  -- one row per product
  SELECT product_id, parent_category, SUM(net_revenue_eur) AS revenue_eur, SUM(units) AS units
  FROM sales
  GROUP BY product_id, parent_category
) AS t
GROUP BY t.parent_category
alternatives:
SELECT parent_category, ROUND(SUM(net_revenue_eur) / SUM(units), 2) AS revenue_per_unit_eur
FROM sales
GROUP BY parent_category

WITH product_totals AS (
  -- one row per product
  SELECT product_id, parent_category, SUM(net_revenue_eur) AS revenue_eur, SUM(units) AS units
  FROM sales
  GROUP BY product_id, parent_category
)
SELECT parent_category, ROUND(SUM(revenue_eur) / SUM(units), 2) AS revenue_per_unit_eur
FROM product_totals
GROUP BY parent_category

other_way.sql:
SELECT parent_category, ROUND(SUM(net_revenue_eur) / SUM(units), 2) AS revenue_per_unit_eur
FROM sales
GROUP BY parent_category
other_way.tradeoff: One GROUP BY over the lines gives the same ratio with no inner step, since sums of sums are just sums.
